criteria_results.title: Flags Item 9.01 financial statements / pro forma requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo explicitly flags the Item 9.01(a)/(b) issue. It states that the draft 8-K's Item 9.01 section marks the requirement 'Not applicable,' which is inadequate because Rule 3-05 of Regulation S-X requires audited financial statements of Ridgeline if any significance test (investment, asset, or income) exceeds 20%, and that Article 11 pro forma financial information would also be required if Rule 3-05 financial statements are triggered. The memo notes the investment test does not trigger (~7%) but that the asset and income tests are undocumented, recommends completing significance testing and either including the financial statements or committing to file by amendment within 71 days, and repeats this in both the Executive Summary and the prioritized action list.

The Timeline Check section also reiterates the 'Rule 3-05/pro forma amendment deadline: 71 days after the initial 8-K due date.' This satisfies the criterion requiring mention of the 71-day amendment deadline for financial statements and pro forma information.
